title: Relative Hamming distance
statement: For a finite nonempty set $\Omega$, a set $\beta$ with decidable equality, and functions $f,g:\Omega\to\beta$, define their relative Hamming distance as the number of inputs on which they differ divided by $|\Omega|$.
